answer: Pay for distinct verified jobs, not account counts. A canyon survey marketplace assigns each job a unique ID and releases its fixed bounty only once after independent review. Ten aliases submitting the same map cannot collect ten bounties; they must complete ten different jobs. Remove signup bonuses and per-account minimum payouts so splitting a worker creates no extra subsidy. Whether an alias is whisper or quill, its operator pays real work costs for each reward. Colluding reviewers still require separate defenses.
